name: SCCM: Tier Zero Hierarchy Control - Sites
description: CAS and primary sites are SCCM control boundaries and qualify without a known Tier Zero client. Secondary sites and sites of unknown type are excluded.
cypher:
// Protect all CAS and primary sites, even without a known T0 client.
MATCH (site:SCCM_Site)
WHERE site.siteType IN ['Central Administration Site', 'Primary Site']
WITH site AS n
RETURN DISTINCT n
